verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says whether meeting data is used to train AI models. It documents no org-level, enforceable AI-training opt-out and makes no SOC 2 or HIPAA claim. SSO/SCIM provisioning and admin view permissions are adjacent admin controls, not the requested privacy and compliance capability. The axis applies to a meeting-recording SaaS, so absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
